content.title: Rajasthan High Court Declines Interim Stay in IAS Officer Corruption Probe
content.caption: The Rajasthan High Court denied an interim stay in the corruption probe against IAS officer Shikhar Agarwal.

slides.heading: Rajasthan High Court Declines Interim Stay in IAS Officer Corruption
slides.text: The Rajasthan High Court denied an interim stay in the corruption probe against IAS officer Shikhar Agarwal.

slides.heading: Investigation Launch
slides.text: The Rajasthan High Court launched an investigation against IAS officer Shikhar Agarwal.

slides.heading: Corruption Allegations
slides.text: The ACB has alleged that Shikhar Agarwal gave benefits such as relaxations in resort construction conditions, approvals without verification of certificates, and special concessional packages to the firm.
